title: The Fretboard Phobia
description: A shy guitarist overcomes stage fright at a local open jam session.
character_reference: a young woman with curly red hair tied in a messy bun, wearing a faded denim jacket and silver hoop earrings

scenes.narration: My guitar felt impossibly heavy as I clutched it in the corner of the crowded room.
scenes.visual: close-up of hands gripping an acoustic guitar neck tightly, warm amber ambient lighting, cozy indoor setting

scenes.narration: Every musician on stage played with a terrifying level of effortless mastery.
scenes.visual: view from the back of a dimly lit room looking toward a stage bathed in warm spotlight, silhouetted audience

scenes.narration: The host called my name, and my stomach instantly dropped into freefall.
scenes.visual: medium shot looking back over a shoulder toward an empty wooden stool under a single spotlight

scenes.narration: I walked to the microphone, feeling every single eye in the room turn toward me.
scenes.visual: low-angle shot walking toward a vintage microphone stand on a small wooden stage, moody shadows

scenes.narration: My fingers stumbled on the first chord, threatening to derail the whole song.
scenes.visual: close-up of fingers missing a guitar fret, blurred background of ambient room lights, emotional tension

scenes.narration: I took a slow breath, remembered the melody, and let my muscle memory take over.
scenes.visual: close-up of fingers strumming guitar strings smoothly, warm stage lighting, shallow depth of field

scenes.narration: When the final chord rang out, the room erupted into genuine applause.
scenes.visual: medium shot looking out from the stage toward smiling audience members clapping in warm light

scenes.narration: Never let fear keep you quiet. Follow along for more everyday victories.
scenes.visual: close-up of a guitar case resting open on a wooden floor, warm lamplight reflecting off metal latches
